methodology: Authorized runtime route verification. HTTP method existence was primarily proven with unauthenticated GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH requests that stop at Lucky authentication; selected GET routes were additionally verified with the repository OpenToken client. No mutating handler was executed for method discovery.

same_bundle_prefix_artifacts.description: Literal-only paths that are strict prefixes of method-bearing routes from the same frontend bundle. Runtime probing confirmed no additional standalone method beyond already cataloged generic/template matches; PATCH probes were also 404. Suppression is version-bound and is not performed by the generic extractor.

no_route_literals.description: Unauthenticated GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH all returned route-not-found semantics on Lucky 3.0.0.

routes.verification: Authenticated GET returned application/octet-stream with a Lucky 3.0.0 ZIP attachment; contents were not inspected.
Unauthenticated POST reached Lucky authentication; handler was not executed.
Authenticated GET with no imageid returned Missing imageid parameter; no real image export was requested.
Plain GET reached the dedicated handler and returned login invalid rather than the generic image lookup response; no WebSocket upgrade was attempted.
GET without path returned PathRequired; a harmless invalid path changed the error to InvalidIconPath.
Unauthenticated GET reached Lucky authentication; handler was not executed. Conservatively classified dangerous because it is a database download/update action.
Authenticated GET returned HTTP 200, ret=0 and the logs query envelope; log contents were not printed.
Plain GET reached the route and returned login invalid; no WebSocket upgrade or NAT probe was started.
Unauthenticated GET reached the handler and returned ret=2 suspicious-request semantics; no temporary code was requested with valid auth context.
Unauthenticated DELETE reached Lucky authentication; no user/token was deleted.
Unauthenticated DELETE reached Lucky authentication; no user/token was deleted.
Unauthenticated DELETE reached Lucky authentication; no user/token was deleted.
Authenticated GET using a deliberately nonexistent key reached the dedicated download handler and returned no found:<key>; no certificate material was returned.
Plain GET reached the WebSocket route and returned login invalid; no Upgrade header was sent.
Unauthenticated POST reached Lucky authentication; no temporary access ticket was created.
Unauthenticated GET reached Lucky authentication; the backup handler was not executed.
